# The Polish rising has been crushed: everything back to GEN, and never again.
wif_gen_poland_crushed = {
	set_global_flag = wif_gen_poland_broken
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 88 state = 10 state = 90 state = 92 state = 91 state = 89 } is_owned_by = POL }
		transfer_state_to = GEN
		set_state_controller_to = GEN
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = GEN } GEN = { add_ideas = wif_gen_poland_broken_idea } }
	news_event = { id = wif_gen.62 days = 1 }
}

# GEN has capitulated to the rising: Poland is reborn.
wif_gen_poland_reborn = {
	set_global_flag = wif_gen_poland_reborn
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 88 state = 10 state = 90 state = 92 state = 91 state = 89 } is_owned_by = GEN }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 91 state = 89 } any_country = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } }
			random_country = { limit = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } save_event_target_as = wif_gen_ukr_heir }
			transfer_state_to = event_target:wif_gen_ukr_heir
		}
		else = { transfer_state_to = POL }
	}
	POL = { remove_ideas = wif_splinter_no_factions }
	news_event = { id = wif_gen.61 days = 1 }
}

# on_capitulation_immediate: ROOT capitulated, FROM the winner.
wif_gen_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = POL has_country_flag = wif_gen_polish_rising NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gen_poland_broken }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = GEN tag = GER is_subject_of = GER is_in_faction_with = GEN } }
		}
		wif_gen_poland_crushed = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = GEN has_global_flag = wif_gen_uprising NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gen_poland_reborn } NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gen_poland_broken } FROM = { tag = POL } }
		wif_gen_poland_reborn = yes
	}
}

# GEN scope, daily: the double-occupation fix. A GEN state owned by a Polish rising but held
# by us or the German side is ours again - owner and controller.
wif_gen_fix_occupation = {
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			OR = { state = 88 state = 10 state = 90 state = 92 state = 91 state = 89 }
			owner = { original_tag = POL }
			controller = { OR = { tag = GEN tag = GER is_subject_of = GER is_in_faction_with = GEN } }
		}
		transfer_state_to = GEN
		set_state_controller_to = GEN
	}
}

# GEN scope, daily.
wif_gen_daily = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gen_setup } } wif_gen_setup = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gen_terror_days > 0 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_gen_terror_days = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gen_terror_days > 0 } } } country_event = { id = wif_gen.20 hours = 6 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_sme_war_pending NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gen_asked } }
		set_country_flag = wif_gen_asked
		country_event = { id = wif_gen.50 days = 2 }
	}
	wif_gen_fix_occupation = yes
}
